summary: Patch buffers adjustable-file yields in a dict keyed by original name, overwriting each pass and flushing once at the end, which correctly collapses duplicate yields while still yielding non-adjustable files/exceptions immediately.

issues.description: Adjustable-file results are now only visible to callers after all passes complete rather than streamed incrementally; acceptable given generator still yields lazily, but slightly changes observable timing for consumers of collectstatic's progress output.
